raw_text: Massive power outages across northeast India. Friends in Guwahati, Shillong, and Agartala all reporting blackouts. POSOCO apparently activated emergency protocols. Some reports suggesting a cyber attack on power grid substations near Bongaigaon. If confirmed, this would be a serious escalation of attacks on Indian critical infrastructure.
clean_text: Widespread power outages across Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura. POSOCO emergency protocols activated. Reports of cyber attack on Bongaigaon substations.
